AbbreviatedTitle.label: Abbreviated title
AbbreviatedTitle.definition: Title as abbreviated for citation, indexing, and/or identification

AccessPolicy.label: Access policy
AccessPolicy.definition: Access restrictions and allowances regarding access to a resource, e.g., lending policy, access restrictions, embargos

AcquisitionSource.label: Acquisition source
AcquisitionSource.definition: Information about an organization, person, etc., from which a resource may be obtained

AdminMetadata.label: Administrative metadata
AdminMetadata.definition: Metadata about the metadata, especially provenance information

Agent.label: Agent
Agent.definition: Entity having a role in a resource, such as a person or organization

AppliedMaterial.label: Applied material
AppliedMaterial.definition: Physical or chemical substance applied to a base material of a resource

Archival.label: Archival controlled
Archival.definition: Resources organically created, accumulated, and/or used by a person, family, or organization in the course of conduct of affairs and preserved because of their continuing value

Arrangement.label: Arrangement
Arrangement.definition: Resource that represents an arrangement of another resource

AspectRatio.label: Aspect ratio
AspectRatio.definition: Proportional relationship between an image's width and its height

Audio.label: Audio
Audio.definition: Resources expressed in an audible form, including music or other sounds

AudioIssueNumber.label: Audio issue number
AudioIssueNumber.definition: Number assigned by publishers of sound recordings to identify the issue designation, or serial identification, of the resource

AudioTake.label: Audio recording take
AudioTake.definition: Identifier assigned to the smallest identifiable unit of a recording session, e.g., a specific recording of an individual song

Barcode.label: Barcode
Barcode.definition: Optical machine-readable representation of data relating to the item to which it is attached

BaseMaterial.label: Base material
BaseMaterial.definition: Underlying physical material of a resource

Binding.label: Binding method
Binding.definition: Information about methods used to bind a published or unpublished resource, or other binding information

BookFormat.label: Book format
BookFormat.definition: Result of folding a printed sheet to form a gathering of leaves

BroadcastStandard.label: Broadcast standard
BroadcastStandard.definition: System used to format a video resource for television broadcast, e.g., HDTV, PAL

Capture.label: Capture of content
Capture.definition: Information about place and date associated with the capture (i.e., recording, filming, etc.) of the content of a resource

CaptureStorage.label: Capture and Storage Technique
CaptureStorage.definition: Specifies the sound capture and storage technique used on a sound recording resource

Carrier.label: Carrier type
Carrier.definition: Categorization reflecting the format of the storage medium and housing of a carrier

Cartographic.label: Cartographic information
Cartographic.definition: Content that represents the whole or part of the earth, any celestial body, or imaginary place at any scale

CartographicDataType.label: Digital cartographic data type
CartographicDataType.definition: Data type for encoding of geospatial information in a cartographic resource, e.g., raster, vector, point

CartographicObjectType.label: Digital cartographic object type
CartographicObjectType.definition: Object type for encoding of geospatial information in a cartographic resource, e.g., point, line, polygon

Cartography.label: Cartography
Cartography.definition: Resource that shows spatial information, including maps, atlases, globes, digital, and other cartographic resources

Chronology.label: Chronology
Chronology.definition: Dates associated with issues or items held

Classification.label: Classification entity
Classification.definition: System of coding and organizing materials according to their subject

ClassificationDdc.label: DDC Classification
ClassificationDdc.definition: Dewey Decimal Classification number used for subject access

ClassificationLcc.label: LCC Classification
ClassificationLcc.definition: Library of Congress Classification number used for subject access

ClassificationNal.label: NAL classification
ClassificationNal.definition: National Library of Agriculture number used for subject access

ClassificationNlm.label: NLM classification
ClassificationNlm.definition: National Library of Medicine Classification number used for subject access

ClassificationUdc.label: UDC Classification
ClassificationUdc.definition: Universal Decimal Classification number used for subject access

Coden.label: CODEN
Coden.definition: Identifier for scientific and technical periodical titles assigned by the International CODEN Section of Chemical Abstracts Service

Collection.label: Collection
Collection.definition: Aggregation of resources, generally gathered together artificially

CollectionArrangement.label: Organization of materials information
CollectionArrangement.definition: Information about the organization and arrangement of a collection of items

CollectiveTitle.label: Collective title
CollectiveTitle.definition: Title for a compilation of resources

ColorContent.label: Color content
ColorContent.definition: Color characteristics of a resource, e.g., black and white, multicolored, etc.

Content.label: Content type
Content.definition: Categorization reflecting the fundamental form of communication in which the content is expressed and the human sense through which it is intended to be perceived

ContentAccessibility.label: Content accessibility information
ContentAccessibility.definition: Information that assists those with a sensory impairment for greater understanding of content, e.g., captions

Contribution.label: Contribution
Contribution.definition: Agent and role with respect to the resource being described

CopyrightNumber.label: Copyright-legal deposit number
CopyrightNumber.definition: Identifier assigned to a copyright registration or legal deposit

CopyrightRegistration.label: Copyright registration
CopyrightRegistration.definition: Copyright or Legal Deposit registration information

Dataset.label: Dataset
Dataset.definition: Data encoded in a defined structure, including numeric data, environmental data, etc., used by applications software

DescriptionAuthentication.label: Metadata authentication
DescriptionAuthentication.definition: Indication of specific types of reviews that have been carried out on the description information

DescriptionConventions.label: Description conventions
DescriptionConventions.definition: Rules used for the descriptive content of the resource description

DescriptionLevel.label: Description level
DescriptionLevel.definition: Designation of the descriptive content of the metadata

DigitalCharacteristic.label: Digital characteristic
DigitalCharacteristic.definition: Technical specification relating to the digital encoding of text, image, audio, video, and other types of data in a resource

Dissertation.label: Dissertation information
Dissertation.definition: Information about a work presented as part of the formal requirements for an academic degree

DissertationIdentifier.label: Dissertation Identifier
DissertationIdentifier.definition: Identifier assigned to a thesis or dissertation for identification purposes

Distribution.label: Distributor
Distribution.definition: Information relating to distribution of a resource

DramaticRole.label: Dramatic role
DramaticRole.definition: The dramatic role performed by a contributing agent

Electronic.label: Electronic
Electronic.definition: Resource that is intended for manipulation by a computer, accessed either directly or remotely

Emulsion.label: Emulsion
Emulsion.definition: Suspension of light-sensitive chemicals used as a coating on a microfilm or microfiche, e.g., silver halide

EncodedBitrate.label: Encoded bitrate
EncodedBitrate.definition: Speed at which streaming audio, video, etc., is designed to play, e.g., 32 kbps

EncodingFormat.label: Encoding format
EncodingFormat.definition: Schema, standard, etc., used to encode the digital content of a resource, e.g., MP3, XML, JPEG

Ensemble.label: Ensemble
Ensemble.definition: Composition of the ensemble, including the size of the ensemble and the medium of performance components

EnsembleSize.label: Ensemble size
EnsembleSize.definition: A designation of the size of the individual musical ensemble

Enumeration.label: Enumeration
Enumeration.definition: Numbering or other enumeration associated with issues or items held

EnumerationAndChronology.label: Enumeration and chronology
EnumerationAndChronology.definition: Numbering or other enumeration and dates associated with issues or items held

Event.label: Event entity
Event.definition: Something that happens at a certain time and location, such as a performance, speech, or athletic event

Extent.label: Extent
Extent.definition: Number and type of units and/or subunits making up a resource

Family.label: Family
Family.definition: Two or more persons related by birth, marriage, adoption, civil union, or similar legal status, or who otherwise present themselves as a family

FileSize.label: File size
FileSize.definition: Number of bytes in a digital file, e.g., 162 KB

FileType.label: File type
FileType.definition: General type of data content encoded in a computer file, e.g., text file, audio file

Fingerprint.label: Fingerprint identifier
Fingerprint.definition: Identifier that is used to assist in the identification of antiquarian books by recording information comprising groups of characters taken from specified positions on specified pages of the book

FontSize.label: Font size
FontSize.definition: Size of the type used to represent the characters and symbols in a resource

Frequency.label: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Information about intervals at which the parts of a serially produced resource or the updates to an integrating resource are issued

Generation.label: Generation
Generation.definition: Relationship between an original carrier and the carrier of a reproduction made from the original

GenerationProcess.label: Generation process
GenerationProcess.definition: Indication of the program or process used to generate the description by application of a particular transformation

GenreForm.label: Genre/form
GenreForm.definition: Form category or genre to which a resource belongs

GeographicCoverage.label: Geographic coverage
GeographicCoverage.definition: Geographic coverage of the content of the resource

GrooveCharacteristic.label: Groove characteristic
GrooveCharacteristic.definition: Groove width of an analog disc or the groove pitch of an analog cylinder, e.g., coarse groove, microgroove

Gtin14Number.label: Global Trade Item Number 14
Gtin14Number.definition: 14-digit number assigned to identify trade items as various packaging levels that encompasses EAN/UCC-128 and ITF-14

Hdl.label: Handle
Hdl.definition: Unique and persistent identifier for digital objects developed by the Corporation for National Research Initiatives

Hub.label: Hub
Hub.definition: An abstract resource that functions as a bridge between two Works

Identifier.label: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Token or name that is associated with a resource, such as a URI or an ISBN

Illustration.label: Illustrative content
Illustration.definition: Information about content intended to illustrate a resource

ImmediateAcquisition.label: Immediate acquisition
ImmediateAcquisition.definition: Information about the circumstances, e.g., source, date, method, under which the resource was directly acquired

Instance.label: Instance
Instance.definition: Resource reflecting an individual, material embodiment of a Work

Integrating.label: Integrating resource
Integrating.definition: Resource that is added to or changed by updates that do not remain discrete but are integrated into the whole

IntendedAudience.label: Intended audience information
IntendedAudience.definition: Information that identifies the specific intended or target audience or intellectual level for which the content described is considered appropriate; also used to record interest and motivation levels and special learner characteristics

Isni.label: ISNI
Isni.definition: International Standard Name Identifier, a unique, persistent reference number for the identities of contributors to creative works

Iso.label: ISO number
Iso.definition: International Organization for Standardization standard number

IssnL.label: ISSN-L
IssnL.definition: International Standard Serial Number that links together various media versions of a continuing resource

Issuance.label: Mode of issuance
Issuance.definition: Information about whether a resource is issued in one or more parts, the way it is updated, and its intended termination

Istc.label: ISTC
Istc.definition: International Standard Text Code, a numbering system developed to enable the unique identification of textual works

Iswc.label: ISWC
Iswc.definition: International Standard Musical Work Code, a unique, persistent reference number for the identification of musical works

Jurisdiction.label: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Legal or political unit administering a geographic area

KeyMode.label: Key and mode
KeyMode.definition: Key and mode, or key only if no mode is present, of a music work

KeyTitle.label: Key title
KeyTitle.definition: Unique title for a continuing resource that is assigned by the ISSN International Center in conjunction with an ISSN

Kit.label: Kit
Kit.definition: Resource that contains a mixture of various components issued as a unit and intended primarily for instructional purposes

Layout.label: Layout
Layout.definition: Arrangement of text, images, tactile notation, etc., in a resource

LcOverseasAcq.label: LC acquisition program
LcOverseasAcq.definition: Identification number assigned by the Library of Congress to works acquired through one of its collaborative overseas acquisition programs

Lccn.label: LCCN
Lccn.definition: Library of Congress Control Number that identifies a resource description

Local.label: Local identifier
Local.definition: Identifier established locally and not a standard number

Manufacture.label: Manufacturer
Manufacture.definition: Information relating to manufacture of a resource

Manuscript.label: Manuscript
Manuscript.definition: Resource which is written in handwriting or typescript

Material.label: Material
Material.definition: Substance or composition of the resource

MatrixNumber.label: Audio matrix number
MatrixNumber.definition: Matrix identifier assigned to the master from which a specific sound recording was pressed

Media.label: Media type
Media.definition: Categorization reflecting the general type of intermediation device required to view, play, run, etc., the content of a resource

MediumComponent.label: Medium component
MediumComponent.definition: An individual component of a medium of performance, gathering together the medium of performance, medium count, number of hands, and component qualifier

MediumComponentQualifier.label: Medium component qualifier
MediumComponentQualifier.definition: Relates a medium component to a qualifier (solo, optional, etc.) that affects the medium component

MediumOfPerformance.label: Medium of performance
MediumOfPerformance.definition: An individual instrument, voice, ensemble, or instrumental group

Meeting.label: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Gathering of individuals or representatives of various bodies for the purpose of discussing and/or acting on topics of common interest

Microform.label: Microform
Microform.definition: Resource that contains microimages, either transparent or opaque, that may be reproductions of existing textual or graphic materials or may be original publications

MixedMaterial.label: Mixed material
MixedMaterial.definition: Resource comprised of multiple types which is not driven by software, e.g. an archival collection of text, photographs and sound recordings

Mode.label: Mode
Mode.definition: Mode (not associated with a key) of a musical work

Modification.label: Modification
Modification.definition: Information relating to modification of a resource

Monograph.label: Monograph
Monograph.definition: Resource that is issued as a single physical unit or intangible single logical unit

Mount.label: Mount
Mount.definition: Physical material or object used for the support or backing to which the base material of a resource has been attached

MovementNotation.label: Movement notation
MovementNotation.definition: Information on the symbol system used to convey the content of a movement resource

MovingImage.label: Moving image
MovingImage.definition: Images intended to be perceived as moving, including motion pictures (using live action and/or animation) or video recordings of performances or events

Multimedia.label: Software or multimedia
Multimedia.definition: Electronic resource which is a computer program or consists of multiple media types that are software driven, such as videogames

MusicAudio.label: Music audio
MusicAudio.definition: Music resource expressed in an audible form

MusicDistributorNumber.label: Music distributor number
MusicDistributorNumber.definition: Identifier appearing on a resource assigned by a distributor to a specific audio recording, notated music publication, music-related publication, or videorecording

MusicEnsemble.label: Music ensemble
MusicEnsemble.definition: Ensemble for which a musical work is appropriate

MusicFormat.label: Notated music format
MusicFormat.definition: Layout for content of a resource that is presented in the form of musical notation

MusicInstrument.label: Musical instrument
MusicInstrument.definition: Instrument for which a musical work is appropriate

MusicMedium.label: Music medium information
MusicMedium.definition: Summary statement of the medium for a musical work

MusicNotation.label: Music notation
MusicNotation.definition: Information on the symbol system used to convey the content of a music resource

MusicPlate.label: Music plate number
MusicPlate.definition: Identifiers assigned by a music publisher or printer to the printing plates for the notated portion of a notated music publication, or an identifier that emulates the printing plate tradition in contemporary publications

MusicPublisherNumber.label: Music publisher number
MusicPublisherNumber.definition: Identifier assigned to a notated music publication other than an issue, matrix, or plate number

MusicVoice.label: Music voice
MusicVoice.definition: Voice for which a musical work is appropriate

Nbn.label: NBN
Nbn.definition: National Bibliography Number that identifies a resource description

NonMusicAudio.label: Non-music audio
NonMusicAudio.definition: Resource expressed in an audible form, including spoken word and other non-musical sounds

NotatedMovement.label: Notated movement
NotatedMovement.definition: Graphic, non-realized representations of movement intended to be perceived visually, e.g. dance

NotatedMusic.label: Notated music
NotatedMusic.definition: Graphic, non-realized representations of musical works intended to be perceived visually

Notation.label: Notation
Notation.definition: Information on the alphabet, script, or symbol system used to convey the content of the resource, including specialized scripts, typefaces, tactile notation, movement notation, and musical notation

Note.label: Note
Note.definition: Information, usually in textual form, on attributes of a resource or some aspect of a resource

Object.label: Three-dimensional object
Object.definition: Resource in a form intended to be perceived visually in three-dimensions, including man-made objects such as models, sculptures, clothing, and toys, as well as naturally occurring objects such as specimens mounted for viewing

ObjectCount.label: Digital cartographic object count
ObjectCount.definition: Number of objects in encoded geospatial information in a cartographic resource

OpusNumber.label: Opus number
OpusNumber.definition: An opus number assigned to a musical work

Organization.label: Organization
Organization.definition: Corporation or group of persons and/or organizations that acts, or may act, as a unit

ParallelTitle.label: Parallel title proper
ParallelTitle.definition: Title in another language and/or script

Person.label: Person
Person.definition: Individual or identity established by an individual (either alone or in collaboration with one or more other individuals)

PlaybackChannels.label: Configuration of playback channels
PlaybackChannels.definition: Configuration/number of sound channels used to make a recording, such as one channel for a monophonic recording, e.g., mono, stereo, quadraphonic, surround

PlaybackCharacteristic.label: Special playback characteristics
PlaybackCharacteristic.definition: Equalization system, noise reduction system, etc., used in making an audio recording, e.g., CCIR standard, CX encoded, Dolby

PlayingSpeed.label: Playing speed
PlayingSpeed.definition: Speed at which an audio carrier must be operated to produce the sound intended, e.g., 78 rpm, 19 cm/s

Polarity.label: Polarity
Polarity.definition: Relationship of the colors and tones in an image to the colors and tones of the object reproduced

PostalRegistration.label: Postal registration number
PostalRegistration.definition: Number assigned to a publication for which the specified postal service permits the use of a special mailing class privilege

PresentationFormat.label: Presentation format
PresentationFormat.definition: Format used in the production of a projected image, e.g., Cinerama, IMAX

PrimaryContribution.label: Primary contribution
PrimaryContribution.definition: Contribution for which the agent is the name chosen as the name part of the name and title access point

Production.label: Producer
Production.definition: Information relating to production of a resource

ProductionMethod.label: Production method
ProductionMethod.definition: Process used to produce a resource

Projection.label: Projection
Projection.definition: Method or system used to represent the surface of the earth or of a celestial sphere on a plane

ProjectionCharacteristic.label: Projection characteristic
ProjectionCharacteristic.definition: Technical specification relating to the projection of a motion picture film

ProjectionSpeed.label: Projection speed
ProjectionSpeed.definition: Speed at which a projected carrier must be operated to produce the moving image intended, e.g., 20 fps

ProvisionActivity.label: Provider entity
ProvisionActivity.definition: Information about the agent or place relating to the publication, printing, distribution, issue, release, or production of a resource

PubFrequency.label: Publication Frequency
PubFrequency.definition: Information about the publication frequency of a resource

Publication.label: Publisher
Publication.definition: Information relating to publication of a resource

PublisherNumber.label: Publisher number
PublisherNumber.definition: Number assigned by a publisher that is not one of the specific defined types

RecordingMedium.label: Recording medium
RecordingMedium.definition: Type of medium used to record sound on an audio carrier, e.g., magnetic, optical

RecordingMethod.label: Type of recording
RecordingMethod.definition: Method used to encode audio content for playback, e.g., analog, digital

ReductionRatio.label: Reduction ratio
ReductionRatio.definition: Size of a micro-image in relation to the original from which it was produced

RegionalEncoding.label: Regional encoding
RegionalEncoding.definition: Identification of the region of the world for which a videodisc has been encoded, e.g., region 4

Relation.label: Relation
Relation.definition: Associated resource and its relationship to the resource being described

Relief.label: Relief
Relief.definition: Relief term specified on a cartographic resource

ReportNumber.label: Technical report number
ReportNumber.definition: Identification number of a technical report that is not a Standard Technical Report Number

Resolution.label: Resolution
Resolution.definition: Clarity or fineness of detail in a digital image, expressed by the measurement of the image in pixels, etc., e.g., 3.1 megapixels

RetentionPolicy.label: Retention policy
RetentionPolicy.definition: Policy of holding institution for retaining resource

Role.label: Role
Role.definition: Function played or provided by a contributor, e.g., author or illustrator

Scale.label: Scale
Scale.definition: Ratio of the dimensions of a form contained or embodied in a resource to the dimensions of the entity it represents, e.g., for images or cartographic resources

Script.label: Script
Script.definition: Information on the script, or symbol system used to convey the content of a text resource

Serial.label: Serial
Serial.definition: Resource that is issued in successive parts, usually numbered, that has no predetermined conclusion

SerialNumber.label: Serial number
SerialNumber.definition: A serial number assigned to a work

Series.label: Series
Series.definition: Resource with a collective title that applies to a group of separate resources, each of which also has its own title

ShelfMark.label: Shelf location
ShelfMark.definition: Piece/item identifier, such as a call or other type of number

ShelfMarkDdc.label: DDC call number
ShelfMarkDdc.definition: Shelf mark based on Dewey Decimal Classification

ShelfMarkLcc.label: LCC call number
ShelfMarkLcc.definition: Shelf mark based on Library of Congress Classification

ShelfMarkNlm.label: NLM call number
ShelfMarkNlm.definition: Shelf mark based on National Library of Medicine Classification

ShelfMarkUdc.label: UDC call number
ShelfMarkUdc.definition: Shelf mark based on Universal Decimal Classification

SoundCharacteristic.label: Sound characteristic
SoundCharacteristic.definition: Technical specification relating to the encoding of sound in a resource

SoundContent.label: Sound content
SoundContent.definition: Indication of whether the production of sound is an integral part of the resource

Source.label: Source
Source.definition: Resource from which value or label came or was derived

Status.label: Status
Status.definition: Designation of the validity or position of something, e.g., whether something is incorrect or available

StillImage.label: Still image
StillImage.definition: Resource expressed through line, shape, shading, etc., intended to be perceived visually as a still image or images in two dimensions, including two-dimensional images and slides and transparencies

StockNumber.label: Stock number
StockNumber.definition: Identification number used for stock purposes and assigned by agencies such as distributors, publishers, or vendors

StudyNumber.label: Study number
StudyNumber.definition: Identification number for a computer data file

Sublocation.label: Sublocation
Sublocation.definition: Specific place within the holding entity where the item is located or made available

Summary.label: Summary
Summary.definition: Description of the content of a resource, such as an abstract, summary, etc.

SupplementaryContent.label: Supplementary material
SupplementaryContent.definition: Index, bibliography, appendix, etc. intended to supplement the primary content of a resource

SystemRequirement.label: System Requirement
SystemRequirement.definition: Equipment or system requirements beyond what is normal and obvious for the type of carrier or type of file, such as make and model of equipment or hardware, operating system, amount of memory, programming language, other necessary software, any plug-ins or peripherals required to play, view, or run the resource

TableOfContents.label: Table of contents
TableOfContents.definition: Table of contents of a resource

Tactile.label: Tactile material
Tactile.definition: Resource that is intended to be perceived by touch

TactileNotation.label: Tactile notation
TactileNotation.definition: Information on the symbol system used to convey the content of a tactile resource

TapeConfig.label: Tape configuration
TapeConfig.definition: Number of tracks on an audiotape, e.g., 12 track

Tempo.label: Tempo
Tempo.definition: The speed of pace of a music work, whether declared in a score or performed

Text.label: Text
Text.definition: Resource intended to be perceived visually and understood through the use of language in written or spoken form

ThematicCatalogNumber.label: Thematic catalog number
ThematicCatalogNumber.definition: A numeric or alphanumeric designation of a musical work as found in a thematic index or catalog

Title.label: Title entity
Title.definition: Title information relating to a resource: work title, preferred title, instance title, transcribed title, translated title, variant form of title, etc.

TrackConfig.label: Track configuration
TrackConfig.definition: Configuration of the audio track on a sound-track film, e.g., center track, edge track

TransliteratedTitle.label: Transliterated title
TransliteratedTitle.definition: Title transliterated from one script to another

Unit.label: Unit
Unit.definition: Units in which a value is expressed

UsageAndAccessPolicy.label: Use and access conditions
UsageAndAccessPolicy.definition: General statement of allowances and restrictions on access to a resource, including retention, reproduction, access, and lending

UsePolicy.label: Use policy
UsePolicy.definition: Usage limitations placed on a resource with respect to reproduction, publication, exhibition, etc.

VariantTitle.label: Title variation
VariantTitle.definition: Title associated with the resource that is different from the Work or Instance title

VideoCharacteristic.label: Video characteristic
VideoCharacteristic.definition: Technical specification relating to the encoding of video images in a resource

VideoFormat.label: Video format
VideoFormat.definition: Standard, etc., used to encode the analog video content of a resource, e.g., Beta, 8mm

VideoRecordingNumber.label: Video recording number
VideoRecordingNumber.definition: Number assigned by a publisher to a video recording

VideogamePlatformId.label: Videogame platform identifier
VideogamePlatformId.definition: An identifier assigned to a videogame platform

Work.label: Work
Work.definition: Resource reflecting a conceptual essence of a cataloging resource

absorbed.label: Absorption of
absorbed.definition: Resource that has been incorporated into another resource
notes: Suggested use - With Work or Instance
Suggested value - Work or Instance

absorbedBy.label: Absorbed by
notes: Suggested use - With Work or Instance
Suggested value - Work or Instance

accompaniedBy.label: Accompanied by
accompaniedBy.definition: Resource that accompanies the described resource
notes: Suggested use - With Work, Instance or Item
Suggested value - Work, Instance or Item

accompanies.label: Accompanies
accompanies.definition: Resource that adds to or is issued with the described resource
notes: Suggested use - With Work, Instance or Item
Suggested value - Work, Instance or Item

acquisitionSource.label: Source of acquisition
acquisitionSource.definition: Information about an organization, person, etc., from which a resource may be obtained.
notes: Suggested use - With Work or Instance

acquisitionTerms.label: Terms of acquisition
acquisitionTerms.definition: Conditions under which the publisher, distributor, etc., will normally supply a resource, e.g., price of a resource.
notes: Suggested use - With Work or Instance

adminMetadata.label: Administrative metadata
adminMetadata.definition: Metadata about the metadata, especially provenance information.

adminMetadataFor.label: Administrative metadata for
adminMetadataFor.definition: Relates an Administrative metadata resource to the resource it captures information about.

agent.label: Associated agent
agent.definition: Entity associated with a resource or element of description, such as the name of the entity responsible for the content or of the publication, printing, distribution, issue, release or production of a resource.
notes: Suggested value - bf:Agent or foaf:Agent

agentOf.label: Associated agent of
agentOf.definition: Property relating an agent, such as an entity responsible for the content or of the publication, printing, distribution, issue, release or production, to another resource.
notes: Suggested use - With bf:Agent or foaf:Agent

appliedMaterial.label: Applied material
appliedMaterial.definition: Physical or chemical substance applied to a base material of a resource.
notes: Suggested use - With Work, Instance or Item

appliedMaterialOf.label: Applied material of
appliedMaterialOf.definition: Relates a Material resource to that which it is the applied material of.

arrangement.label: Arrangement
arrangement.definition: Relates one resource to another of which it is an arrangement of the first

arrangementOf.label: Arrangement of
arrangementOf.definition: Relates an arrangement to the resource of which it is an arrangement.

ascensionAndDeclination.label: Cartographic ascension and declination
ascensionAndDeclination.definition: System for identifying the location of a celestial object in the sky covered by the cartographic content of a resource using the angles of right ascension and declination.

aspectRatio.label: Aspect ratio
aspectRatio.definition: Proportional relationship between an image's width and its height.
notes: Suggested use - With Work or Instance

assigner.label: Assigner
assigner.definition: Entity that assigned the metadata, such as the entity that assigned a classification number, entity that assigned a name, entity that assigned an identifier.

associatedResource.label: Associated resource
notes: Suggested value - With Work or Hub

awards.label: Award note
awards.definition: Information on awards associated with the described resource.
notes: Suggested use - With Work or Instance

baseMaterial.label: Base material
baseMaterial.definition: Underlying physical material of a resource.
notes: Suggested use - With Work, Instance or Item

baseMaterialOf.label: Base material of
baseMaterialOf.definition: Relates a Material resource to that which it is the base material of.

binding.label: Binding method
binding.definition: A method used to bind a published or unpublished resource,or other binding information.

bookFormat.label: Book format
bookFormat.definition: Result of folding a printed sheet to form a gathering of leaves.

capture.label: Capture of content
capture.definition: Information about place and date associated with the capture (e.g., recording, filming) of the content of a resource.
notes: Suggested use - With Work or Instance

carrier.label: Carrier type
carrier.definition: Categorization reflecting the format of the storage medium and housing of a carrier.
notes: Suggested value - bf:Carrier or skos:Concept

cartographicAttributes.label: Cartographic data
cartographicAttributes.definition: Cartographic data that identifies characteristics of the resource, such as coordinates, projection, etc.
notes: Suggested use - With Work or Instance

changeDate.label: Description change date
changeDate.definition: Date or date and time on which the metadata was modified

classification.label: Classification
notes: Suggested use - With Work, Instance or Item

classificationPortion.label: Classification number
classificationPortion.definition: Classification number (single class number or beginning number of a span) that indicates the subject by applying a formal system of coding and organizing resources.

code.label: Code
code.definition: String of characters that serves as a code representing information.

collectionArrangement.label: Collection Organization and arrangement
collectionArrangement.definition: Information about the organization and arrangement of a collection of resources.

validDate.label: Valid date

variantType.label: Variant title type
variantType.definition: Type of title variation, e.g., acronym, cover, spine, earlier, later, series version.

version.label: Version
version.definition: Term or terms that identify works such as arranged for music, vulgate for religious work, etc.

videoCharacteristic.label: Video characteristic
videoCharacteristic.definition: Technical specification relating to the encoding of video images in a resource

voice.label: Voice
voice.definition: Voice for which a musical work is appropriate, such as soprano, tenor, mixed.

voiceType.label: Type of voice
voiceType.definition: Specific type of voice group, such as chorus, solo.
